mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Chat composer and Models provider disclosure reached; detailed receipts, explicit provider check/test-policy controls API-only.
Not app-shipped initiation: delegation tool-only; existing-helper follow-up is conditional and unproved by this empty-home crawl.
Partial: Tasks and empty-state door reached; existing-task review is conditional. Structured brief creation API-only.
Conditional surface only: Tasks reached; evidence/check/history sheets need existing tasks and were not exercised.
Not shipped: decision journal absent; template-use statistics are backend-only.
Partial: Rules region and scheduled-workflow setup form reached. Generic rule create/edit/fire/history and full message inbox API-only.
Partial: Memory and remember prompt reached; populated edit/forget/provenance conditional. Full history/confirm/typed provenance and standalone export API-only.
Not app-shipped receipt browser: API-only receipts/egress log. Health aggregate counts are a narrower status surface.
Present controls: names and directness reached; model-independent prompt enforcement remains backend evidence.
Not shipped: deliberation/critic absent.
Partial: decision seat form reached; general request/template/policy editor absent; live Jev not verified.

mappings.capability: Ingest security gate (prompt-injection screen for outside content)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: outside-content status, screening opt-in and empty Capture reached. Per-event approvals/verdicts conditional; full audit-record browser absent.

mappings.capability: Local decision provider for the Jev seat (Tev1 via Ollama)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Tev1/seat configuration and availability/status reached. Advisory only for failed ingest eval; real cloud seat unverified.
Partial: decision seat form and Capture reached; populated verdicts conditional. General registry/log editor absent; memory gate and recall-path screening not live.

mappings.capability: Golden-task eval harness (regression gate, capability suite, injection suite)
mappings.app_shipping: CI/developer mechanism, not an app-run eval suite. Models reached; wired score summaries source-audited, not exercised with scored models; no run/case explorer.
Partial: Models reached; assigned/recommended score summaries are wired by source audit. Scored records conditional; full provider/model history and app eval runs not shipped.

mappings.capability: Claims register (capabilities claimed vs. what the suite demonstrates)
mappings.app_shipping: CI/developer-only claims register; not an app feature.

mappings.capability: Cost ceilings on autonomous work (per task and per day: steps, tokens, priced dollars), loop detector, resume as a new approval
mappings.app_shipping: Not shipped: autonomous-run caps inert; model inference Cloud budget is a different feature.

mappings.capability: One-click diagnostics bundle, redacted by construction (no secret, no personal content, local only)
mappings.app_shipping: Not shipped: diagnostics route/Health download unwired; integrity scrub absent.
Partial surface: Changes list reached; existing template review/ship/rollback conditional. Template authoring/registry/cache/dry-run controls absent.
Partial: legacy permission switches and Tasks reached; populated approval sheets conditional. Full per-capability tier editor absent.
Partial surface: Changes list reached; existing proposal review/ship/rollback conditional. Proposal creation and foundry invocation API-only.

mappings.capability: Service orchestration: the Service Manager and its drivers (owner input 2026-10-31)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Home/Devices/Services map doors reached. New definitions, plan/argv, deploy/recover and placement simulation API/CLI-only; K3s and unsupported drivers not shipped.

mappings.capability: Device pairing (QR / code / command) + hub approval
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Devices and mesh prerequisite/install instructions reached. Pairing/approval/roles/revoke conditional on listener, permissions and devices; not exercised.
Conditional surface only: Devices/Health reached; promotion/settlement needs standby/candidate records. Standby enrollment, policy/name setup and rehearsal not app-shipped.

mappings.capability: Two device agents (boot + runtime, never merged)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial status/instructions only: Devices/Health/map reached; runtime publishing, workload install and queue management lack app controls.
Partial: visible Capture category, source form, rules/retention and timeline door reached. Events/consent toggles/verdicts conditional; raw-original and spoke acknowledgement diagnostics API-only.

mappings.capability: Local model management (detect HW, recommend, download, serve)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: hardware/recommendation status, download buttons and disk form reached. Installed actions conditional; arbitrary assignments/WOL config API/profile-only.
Partial: privacy mode and model Cloud budget reached; task wait/fallback conditional. Detailed receipts/usage/alternate-chain explorer absent.
Not shipped voice chat: Chat microphone is browser-dependent dictation only, not a spoken conversation channel.
Partial: Skills install/folder/zip controls and connector setup reached. Generic extension lifecycle API-only; MCP/plugin code execution not shipped.
Partial kind-specific surfaces reached; existing extension-change review conditional. Generic manifest lifecycle/permission-diff/proposal creation API-only.

mappings.capability: Agent adapters: Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT/dots, Gemini, Copilot
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: provider disclosure and Tasks reached; task review conditional. Standalone/coding initiation lacks specific prompt/door; missing adapters/live checks remain unshipped.
Partial: provider disclosure and schedules reached; n8n setup behind disclosure not exercised. Task initiation/history/token regeneration API/tool-only; Zapier/Make not built.

mappings.capability: Smart-home bridges (Home Assistant, Apple Home via bridges, Scrypted)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Home Assistant URL/token/connect form reached. Entity/state/service actions and tier3 domain settings API-only; Smart Home/Apple/Scrypted not shipped.
Partial: Gmail setup form/connection disclosure reached. Specific mail Try prompt depends installed skill; mailbox/draft/label dashboard absent; no live account tested.
Conditional surface only: Tasks reached; existing browser takeover requires open task and was not exercised. Browser-task initiation API-only; desktop control absent.

mappings.capability: Nova Computer: sandboxed workspaces per project (Execution Plane)
mappings.app_shipping: Not app-shipped: every Nova Computer workspace action API-only; no Computer view or discoverable chat tool.

mappings.capability: Nova Browser: Nova's own browser, co-pilot, vault logins, site templates, checkout stop (Execution Plane)
mappings.app_shipping: Partial: Site sign-ins disclosure and Tasks reached; sign-in form and existing takeover not exercised. Browser start/checkout/flow learn/list/replay API-only; vision absent.
Not discoverably app-shipped initiation: coding tools exist without specific prompt/door. Existing review/merge sheets conditional; editable allow-list API-only.
Not end-to-end app-shipped: infrastructure setup API-only, initiation tool-only. Existing apply approval conditional; no real provider proof.

mappings.capability: Networking changes with a dead-man's switch (Execution Plane)
mappings.app_shipping: Not end-to-end app-shipped: target/token/window/revert setup API-only, initiation tool-only. Existing approval/contact/revert sheets conditional.
Partial connection/sign-in disclosure; account/password/MFA initiation tool/API-only without prompt. Existing task review conditional; pending-password recovery API-only.
Partial: provider disclosure and Tasks reached; Relay config/results conditional. Run initiation lacks specific door; live Relay/cleanup unproved.
Present app shell and install instructions reached in both arrangements. Native installation, real phone/foldable and offline guarantees not proved by this crawl.
Partial: appearance controls and Changes reached. Custom package author/import/validate/foundry API-only; live swap not executed by read-only crawl.

mappings.capability: Themes with identical features per layout
mappings.app_shipping: Reachability present: eleven registered views and ordinary homes reached in phone/rail. Not a claim every conditional feature, theme or hardware posture was exercised.
Partial: Problems/Checks/Keeping Nova running and map reached. Repairs/backup/drill conditional; console code-release deploy and backup configuration lack app controls.
Onboarding-only, outside normal Home crawl: no repeat discovery/import door. Fresh-user wizard has separate existing gate; no new pass claimed here.
Partial: Checkpoints list/Create control and Health reached. Restore/delete/backup/drill conditional; nightly/encrypted target, recovery key and encrypted drill setup API-only.
Partial: purpose-specific secret input/status surfaces reached. Generic vault CRUD/reset/recovery API-only; broker replacement not shipped; security guarantees remain UNPROVEN as recorded.
